leads.skip_prompt: Skip every Inbox lead scoring below:
leads.skip_confirm: Skip {count} leads scoring below {n}? You can find them under Skipped.
leads.empty_text: Search for people who are hiring, or local businesses that need help.
leads.empty_stage_text: Change the filters or pick another stage above.
leads.pick_text: Select one on the left. Keys: j / k to move, s shortlist, x skip, c contacted, g write message.
msg.ph: Click "Write message" to draft a first message from this lead's details. You review it and send it yourself.
msg.ai_setup: Set up an AI provider in Settings first
msg.ai_failed: AI failed, used the template instead: {err}
audit.blocked: This site blocked the automated check (bot protection). Open it in your browser and look yourself before pitching.
audit.ok: No issues found. This site looks fine; pitch something else or move on.
find.hiring_desc: Finds posts where someone asks for a freelancer, ranked by how well they match your skills.
src_desc.freelancer: New client projects in your categories, worldwide
src_desc.reddit: Hiring posts in r/forhire and the communities from Settings
src_desc.hn: "Seeking freelancer" and contract posts from the monthly threads
src_desc.github: Open issues with bounty and help-wanted labels
src_desc.mastodon: Fediverse posts asking for help, any language (fewer, noisier)
src_desc.rss: Job board feeds you added in Settings
find.search_hint: Takes about a minute. Some sites are slow on purpose to stay polite.
find.local_desc: Finds businesses near any place in the world and checks their websites for problems you can fix.
find.kind_q: What kind of business? (click to choose)
find.other_ph: Other: an OpenStreetMap tag like shop=bicycle
find.check_sites_hint: Slower, but this is what gives you something concrete to say.
find.local_tip: Tip: "Only without a website" is the quickest way to find clients who need a site.
find.check_desc: Paste any business website to see what is wrong with it and get a ready-made pitch.
find.booking: This business takes bookings (restaurant, clinic, salon…)
find.pick_kind: Choose at least one kind of business
err.429: The site asked us to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
err.notfound: That place was not found. Try adding the country.
set.draft_language_hint: Automatic writes to each business in its own language
set.about_desc: Used to rank leads and write your messages.
set.profession_hint: Fills in skills, pitch, sources and business types for this kind of work. You can edit everything after.
set.name: Your name
set.signature_hint: How you sign messages, e.g. Name | website
set.pitch: What you do, in one sentence
set.skills_hint: Comma separated. Leads that mention these rank higher.
set.avoid_hint: Leads with these are pushed down hard.
set.freelancer_hint: Live client projects worldwide, the richest source for most work
set.freelancer_cats_hint: Comma separated, e.g. Website-Design, Translation, Logo-Design
set.mastodon_hint: Worldwide and multilingual, but few and noisy results
set.gh_token_hint: set the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable for higher limits
set.ai_desc: Without this, messages come from translated templates. With it, an AI writes a draft from the lead's details. You still review and send it.
set.keys_hint: keys are read from environment variables and never saved to disk
wiz.welcome_text: Tell it what you do, and it will find people and businesses that need exactly that.
wiz.what: What kind of work do you do?
wiz.pick_one: Pick the work closest to yours
wiz.name: Your name
wiz.first_text: leadhound will look for people hiring right now. You can also search local businesses near you.
wiz.city_hint: Leave empty to only search for hiring posts
login.title: Sign in
quit.title: leadhound has stopped
quit.text: You can close this tab. Open leadhound again from the desktop icon.
today.empty_text: Click the big button. leadhound looks for people who need your work right now.
today.city_q: Want local businesses too? Add your city:
today.done_text: No new matches right now. Click "Find new clients" again later.
today.msg_hint: Read it, change anything you like, then send it yourself.
today.no_contact: No contact details found. Use "Open the page" to reach them there.
